metadata.case_name: WONG KA WAI JOHNNY v. LEE MAN WAI

plaintiff.occupation_before: security officer of Royal Elite working at the lobby of the Development

injuries.description: Tenderness and bruising on right knee
source: He was found to have tenderness and bruising on his right knee.

there was only mild bruising and tenderness over his right knee and he was discharged from the hospital with analgesic on the day of the Assault, according to the medical report of Dr. Chu of the Accident & Emergency Department of Princess Margaret Hospital.

injuries.description: Adjustment Disorder with Mixed Anxiety and Depressive Mood
source: Both Dr Chow and Dr Chen agreed that Johnny Wong suffered from (1) Adjustment Disorder with Mixed Anxiety and Depressive Mood (Code 309.0) and (2) PTSD (Code 309.81).
injuries.icd_description: Adjustment Disorder with Mixed Anxiety and Depressive Mood

source: Both Dr Chow and Dr Chen agreed that Johnny Wong suffered from (1) Adjustment Disorder with Mixed Anxiety and Depressive Mood (Code 309.0) and (2) PTSD (Code 309.81).

manifestations.description: Tenderness and bruising on his right knee
Unable to concentrate on his work
Apprehensive about work / fear of being attacked
Social withdrawal / loss of interest in gathering with friends and outdoor group activities
Suicidal idea (reported at time of presentation)
Aggressive behaviour (throwing a chair and an umbrella) observed in hospital

treatments_received: sent to Princess Margaret Hospital Accident & Emergency Department
hospitalized at Kwai Chung Hospital for 6 days
psychological treatment (Li Ka Shing Outpatient Clinic / Prince of Wales Hospital / outpatient follow-up)
treatments_future: biweekly follow-up treatment by both psychiatrist and clinical psychologist for six months

losses.description: mild bruising and tenderness over his right knee
He has lost interests in gathering with friends and all kinds of outdoor group activities; he is socially withdrawn.

Loss of earning capacity; assessed by experts (Dr Chow 7%, Dr Chen 5%); parties agreed HK$50,000 for loss of earning capacity; he will be less willing to work night shift and fearful of being attacked as a security guard.

Both Dr Chow and Dr Chen agreed that Johnny Wong suffered from (1) Adjustment Disorder with Mixed Anxiety and Depressive Mood (Code 309.0) and (2) PTSD (Code 309.81).
